## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与结果

Requirement record (behavior changes): docs/requirements/<id>.md

## Scope and compatibility / 范围与兼容性

Describe affected modules, interface/data changes and excluded scope. Do not include real captures or credentials.

## Acceptance evidence / 验收证据

| Criterion | Scenario | Command or operation and actual result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-1 | | |

`npm run verify`: result, date, revision and CI/report link.
UI / desktop / real Agent checks: environment, steps and results. Explicitly list anything not verified.

## Risks and rollback / 风险与回退

Explain proxy/CA impact, migration backup and whether the prior version can read the resulting data. Unknown or unexecuted checks must not be represented as passed.
